decisions.reason: A compact dumper with rotating skip builds directly on the firm's long-standing construction machinery knowledge, so the firm can read early market feedback and refine the product easily.
An articulated construction dumper sits at the core of the firm's established competence, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from early results and improve the product.

The mine rescue vehicle is a more specialised niche, but it likely shares chassis and drivetrain know-how with the firm's articulated vehicles, and one year is too short to judge it, so it stays despite somewhat higher uncertainty.
A compact telescopic loader is closely related to the firm's compact construction equipment knowledge, and only one year of feedback is too little to justify dropping it.
